adjudication.rationale: Although there is no spec that instantiates `PostCreator` with `cook_method:` directly, the new passthrough in `lib/post_creator.rb` is exercised (not merely “incidentally”) by `TopicEmbed.import`, which calls `PostCreator.new(..., cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])`. `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb` then asserts both `post.cook_method == :raw_html` and `post.cooked == post.raw`, which would fail if `PostCreator` used the wrong opts key or set it too late (after cooking). So the claim that regressions in PostCreator’s handling would only be caught incidentally is not supported by the diff.
